◆ Planar Ornament Extraction System Details ◆
● Based on operational efficiency reviews, Screwllum has optimized and upgraded the Planar Ornament system!
● Save Files can be used when clearing Divergent Universe stages to directly perform Boss Challenges and obtain Planar Ornaments.

◆ Save File Usage Details ◆
● When clearing Ordinary Extrapolation and Cyclical Extrapolation in the Divergent Universe, stage clear data can be saved in a Save File.
● Save Files can be loaded in the Planar Ornament Extraction system's stages to directly initiate Boss Challenges. Respective Planar Ornaments for the corresponding stage will be obtained with successful challenges.
● Save Files will be reset during the Simulated Universe expansions and updates.

◆ Boss Challenge Details ◆
● When the Equilibrium Level is increased, the Planar Ornament Extraction system will unlock challenges of higher difficulties. The harder the challenge, the more rewards earned. Of course, enemies will be stronger too.
● Boss difficulty in the Planar Ornament Extraction system is only linked to the challenge's difficulty, and is not related to the Save File's stage clear difficulty.
● Teams performing Boss Challenges can be freely swapped, and players may deploy 1 Support character to assist in battle.

◆ Event Participation Rules ◆
● The event is divided into 7 phases, with a new phase of the prize draw being released each day starting from the 1st day of the event.
● Trailblazers can choose to participate in the prize draw or directly claim a fixed reward of <unbreak>100</unbreak> Stellar Jades before the deadline of each phase (specific times are shown on the event interface). Only one option can be selected. Different options can be picked for each phase.
● If no action is taken during the prize draw period, the default reward of fixed Stellar Jades will be granted, and the prize draw will not be participated in. After the event begins, aside from the prize draw or fixed rewards, you can also directly claim a reward of <unbreak>100</unbreak> Stellar Jades as a Lucky Blessing. If Trailblazers do not log in during the prize draw period, they can still log in before the event ends to claim a one-time reward of <unbreak>800</unbreak> Stellar Jades.
● Each phase's prize draw results will be announced the following day, with specific times displayed on the event interface.
